name: Pineapple Lentil Curry
author: haywalk on based.cooking
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic. Sauté about 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in curry powder and cook about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add all other ingredients. Stir well.
Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
